summary: Issue 6 — Wellness Week. Page 1: Welcome to Wellness. Standardized wellness arrives as the administrative consequence of Issue 5's boundary.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The operations level is covered in polished StarTrust wellness banners.
PANEL 2 — Astra reads the participation line twice.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb studies the program packet with sincere interest.
PANEL 4 — Zib is standing behind the banner, staring at a service panel it partly covers.
PANEL 5 — Zib taps the wall.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: That is at least one contradiction before coffee.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: There may be one useful thing in here.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: There is one useful thing behind it.

summary: Page 2: The Room. The mandatory wellness schedule occupies exactly the room Zib needs for a ventilation-damper service.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The multipurpose room is arranged for wellness sessions. A portable screen blocks the ventilation-damper service chase.
PANEL 2 — Zib shows Astra the maintenance ticket.
PANEL 3 — Pixa displays the room schedule.
PANEL 4 — Zib looks at the current time: 09:52.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks at the packed corporate schedule.
PANEL 6 — Zib shrugs. Astra looks at the wellness chairs.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: Service access window available at eighteen-thirty.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Yes. The room gets warmer and everyone complains.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: So the baseline comes with a control group.

summary: Page 3: Kreeb's Quiet Room. Kreeb salvages a genuinely useful care space by keeping corporate forms outside it.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Kreeb sets up a small adjacent quiet room with ordinary chairs, water, and no corporate slogans.
PANEL 2 — Kreeb puts up one simple card.
PANEL 3 — Glorp arrives carrying a participation sheet.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb points outside the room.
PANEL 5 — Glorp checks the requirement.
PANEL 6 — Kreeb opens the door.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: It asks whether the room was used.

summary: Page 4: Mindful Pauses. Jax complies accidentally while continuing his actual work.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax's required wellness tracker flashes when he stands still waiting for a cargo lift.
PANEL 2 — Pixa logs the event.
PANEL 3 — Jax looks at the tracker.
PANEL 4 — Pixa answers literally.
PANEL 5 — Jax considers the possibilities.
PANEL 6 — Astra passes him.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I was waiting for the lift.

summary: Page 5: The Required Optional Field. Glorp discovers that optional disclosure is still pressured by a required-response field, while NO ENTRY exists as a valid value.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp reviews the wellness completion form.
PANEL 2 — One field is marked optional while a red marker beside it requires a response.
PANEL 3 — Glorp turns to Pixa.
PANEL 4 — Pixa opens the allowed values.
PANEL 5 — Glorp is not reassured.
PANEL 6 — Kreeb smiles faintly.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: If disclosure is optional, why is the field required?

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: Then NO ENTRY is an entry.

summary: Page 6: Mira's Baseline. Mira defines a physical observation set and refuses to infer feelings or material causation from wellness exercises.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira sets up a deliberately boring observation sheet.
PANEL 2 — The sheet lists only physical and attendance categories.
PANEL 3 — Astra scans it.
PANEL 4 — Mira looks offended by the suggestion.
PANEL 5 — Astra points at the sentence.
PANEL 6 — Pixa begins to respond; Astra cuts it off.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: ambient temperature; equipment load; attendance; session exits; sample mass; sample physical properties.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: I can tell you the room is warmer. I cannot tell you whether breathing exercises caused a mineral.

summary: Page 7: Calm Tones. The wellness setup physically obstructs service access while Astra still tries to keep the baseline on schedule.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The wellness session begins. A corporate speaker plays slow synthetic calm tones.
PANEL 2 — Zib notices the speaker has been mounted directly in front of the service panel.
PANEL 3 — Astra is trying to keep the baseline on schedule.
PANEL 4 — Zib looks at the speaker, then at her.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb answers from the circle of chairs.
PANEL 6 — Astra checks the remaining session time and does not yet cancel it.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: That speaker is on my panel.

summary: Page 8: The Room Gets Warmer. Observable physical conditions deteriorate exactly as Zib predicted.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Twenty minutes later. People are visibly uncomfortable, but Pixa reports only observable data.
PANEL 2 — Mira checks the environmental monitor.
PANEL 3 — Astra follows her gaze to the blocked damper panel.
PANEL 4 — Zib is already holding a screwdriver.
PANEL 5 — Astra exhales.

summary: Page 9: Pause the Baseline. Astra sacrifices the cleaner wellness record because the program itself has contaminated the physical baseline.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra looks at the wellness schedule.
PANEL 2 — Zib points at the wall.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb looks around the overheated room.
PANEL 4 — Astra remains focused on the pilot requirement.
PANEL 5 — Mira shows her the environmental log.
PANEL 6 — Astra gives up the cleaner record.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: We have forty minutes left in the required block.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Damper has been waiting three hours.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: The room is not helping anyone now.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: If we cancel, the baseline is incomplete.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: If we don't, the baseline is contaminated by a maintenance condition.

summary: Page 10: Access. The wellness group clears out and the physical station finally gets access to its own service panel.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The wellness group clears the room.
PANEL 2 — Jax unhooks the corporate speaker and carries it away while it continues playing calm tones.
PANEL 3 — The speaker continues its wellness instruction as Jax carries it away.
PANEL 4 — Zib opens the service panel at last.
PANEL 5 — Pixa updates the schedule.
PANEL 6 — Glorp searches the wellness guide.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: That status is not in the program.

summary: Page 11: The Actual Problem. The grand conflict reduces to a binding damper hinge and a ten-minute repair.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Inside the service chase, the ventilation damper is simply binding at one hinge.
PANEL 2 — Zib works on it.
PANEL 3 — Mira watches the environmental monitor while he repairs it.
PANEL 4 — The damper cycles cleanly.
PANEL 5 — Room temperature begins returning toward normal.
PANEL 6 — Astra looks at Mira.

summary: Page 12: No Entry. Jax uses the optional-reflection process exactly as written and chooses NO ENTRY without turning privacy into avoidance of work.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — After the interrupted session, the wellness completion prompt appears for everyone.
PANEL 2 — Jax's optional-reflection field offers two values.
PANEL 3 — Jax selects NO ENTRY without hesitation.
PANEL 4 — Pixa confirms.
PANEL 5 — Jax looks at the completed form.
PANEL 6 — Nearby, another worker hovers uncertainly over the same choice while Glorp watches the compliance status.

summary: Page 13: No One Owes a Feeling. Kreeb separates participation traceability from emotional disclosure.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp approaches the hesitant worker with the completion checklist.
PANEL 2 — The worker looks uncomfortable.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb steps beside Glorp, not between them and the worker.
PANEL 4 — Glorp points at the record requirement.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb points at the available NO ENTRY option.
PANEL 6 — Glorp pauses.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: The participation record still needs a final state.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: They owe a completed participation record.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: Then record that they participated and did not disclose.

summary: Page 14: Glorp Chooses Accuracy. Glorp accepts a truthful completed state that records participation without content.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp opens the local completion procedure.
PANEL 2 — They add a valid final state.
PANEL 3 — Glorp looks at Kreeb.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb asks simply.
PANEL 5 — Glorp answers after thinking about it.
PANEL 6 — Kreeb nods. Glorp saves the change.

summary: Page 15: Quiet Without a Program. The useful care practice survives only after the tracker and corporate session disappear.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The repaired room is cooler. Kreeb reopens the quiet room with no tracker and no corporate session running.
PANEL 2 — Jax sits with coffee for two silent minutes.
PANEL 3 — Astra enters, starts to speak, and decides not to.
PANEL 4 — Noola sits nearby.
PANEL 5 — Mira checks the wall temperature.
PANEL 6 — Noola looks at her.

summary: Page 16: Data Does Not Cooperate. Mira can defend improved ventilation, not a wellness effect on material.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira compares the pre-session, overheated-session, repair, and post-repair records.
PANEL 2 — She shows Astra the result.
PANEL 3 — Astra points at the sample column.
PANEL 4 — Mira looks toward the repaired damper.
PANEL 5 — Zib passes the doorway.
PANEL 6 — Pixa reports the material conclusion.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Can we say it improved anything?

summary: Page 17: The Null Result. Astra sends the day they actually had, including the maintenance confound and absence of a defensible material effect.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra drafts the baseline report with Mira, Glorp, and Kreeb present.
PANEL 2 — The visible summary records participation, optional disclosure, the maintenance interruption, and no defensible material effect.
PANEL 3 — Mira reads it.
PANEL 4 — Glorp and Kreeb read the same text.
PANEL 5 — Astra sends it.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: participation completed; disclosure optional; NO ENTRY accepted; maintenance interruption changed conditions; no defensible material effect identified.

summary: Page 18: Great Learnings. Corporate treats the honest low-disclosure null result as a reason for a supplemental disclosure program.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Corporate response arrives.
PANEL 2 — A second line reframes low disclosure as an interpretability problem.
PANEL 3 — A third line recommends a supplemental initiative.
PANEL 4 — Astra reads it.
PANEL 5 — Pixa opens the participation rule.
PANEL 6 — Astra points at the wording.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: Participation in the supplemental initiative is required. Disclosure remains optional.

summary: Page 19: Not a Failure. Kreeb reminds Astra that the null result still protected the right not to disclose.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra, Mira, and Kreeb remain after the reply.
PANEL 2 — Astra leans back.
PANEL 3 — Mira answers immediately.
PANEL 4 — Astra looks at the corporate message.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb points at the accepted NO ENTRY procedure.
PANEL 6 — Astra looks at it, then nods.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: We gave them a null result and they gave us a sequel.

summary: Page 20: A Form That Permits Absence. Jax's completed record is true precisely because it records participation without disclosure.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax drops his completed wellness tracker on Glorp's desk.
PANEL 2 — He summarizes it.
PANEL 3 — Glorp checks the record.
PANEL 4 — Jax studies Glorp's expression.
PANEL 5 — Glorp considers the new NO ENTRY rule.
PANEL 6 — Jax heads back to work.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I participated. I disclosed nothing. I moved a speaker.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: I am adjusting to a form that permits absence.

summary: Page 21: What Stays. Corporate branding leaves; clear service access, the quiet room, and the valid NO ENTRY rule remain.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The corporate wellness banners come down.
PANEL 2 — Zib restores clear service access to the damper panel.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb keeps the quiet-room sign but removes the StarTrust branding.
PANEL 4 — Glorp adds one small line beneath it.
PANEL 5 — Astra notices the addition.
PANEL 6 — Glorp looks at her.

summary: Page 22: Tag — Feelings Day. The next program arrives immediately; Jax's emotional privacy is now an established valid state rather than a failure to participate.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A printer produces a fresh corporate placard.
PANEL 2 — A smaller participation line appears beneath it.
PANEL 3 — Jax reads it.
PANEL 4 — Noola walks past.
PANEL 5 — Jax looks back at the NO ENTRY sign. Astra checks the date: tomorrow.

dialogueInline.speaker: SIGN
dialogueInline.text: BRING YOUR FEELINGS TO WORK DAY.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I am bringing mine in a sealed container.
